name: STAT 3375Q
title: Introduction to Mathematical Statistics I
description: The mathematical theory underlying statistical methods. Probability spaces, distributions in one and several dimensions, generating functions, and limit theorems.
requirement_description: A grade of C+ or better in MATH 2110Q or 2130Q. Not open for credit to students who have passed STAT 3345Q or 5585. May not be taken out of sequence after passing STAT 3445Q.
